component.name: Omamusic
component.summary: Minimalist local music player for Omarchy

description.p: Local music library with optional online tag and cover lookup (MusicBrainz, AcoustID, Deezer). No accounts or codecs required.

A SQLite-backed library with album, artist and song views, BM25 full-text search, cover art, shuffle and repeat, MPRIS media integration, and a system tray icon — rendered in GPUI and following the live Omarchy theme.
